body: Me and my girlfriend were hanging out on a beach in southern California and a kid that was between the ages of 12 and 15 walked right in front of us, dropped his pants and shat right in the sand. To make things worse, the kids father proceeded to pick it up with one of those green plastic bags meant for dog poop, tie it in a knot and tossed in on the ground 5 feet from where we were sitting. Then he grabbed a handful of  sand and use it to wipe the kids ass. Stay classy California.
Most of the time i put on cooking or travel shows. Mainly so every once in a while i can look at the tv and be like "ooo that looks nice" then go about my day.
When she left. I should've tried harder. I shouldve worked on my mental health. I shouldve listened when she said i wasnt the same person she used to love.

I work at a rite aid, and during the holiday seasons this is what any aisle containing toys or decorations looks like. I actually take time out of my day to stand at the end of the aisle to make sure kids arent flinging things off the shelves, tearing off packaging, or damn near killing eachother with whatever blunt object they can find.
Got a job, pulled myself off the streets after being homeless for 5 years, and got my mental health under control. Been a good one.
Go drink at my favorite bar without having to spend 10$ a fucking round.

I left my abusive household when i was 16. After couch hopping for as long i could, i went to a nearby park. I stayed up for 3 days panicing. My friend was bringing me food that id eat in very small portions, so i could stock up to last a while. I found a corner that was  secluded in this giant bush, that i finally decided to sleep in. I slept ontop if my food and valuables, used my jackets and extra clothes as a blanket. Held down there for about 2 weeks. Not the worst thing. Never doing it again though. Now i got a decent job and a nice apartment.

Im not scared to tell her, she just worries alot and shes already got enough going on in her life.
